title: kith-store: set_blocked advances state counter even when value is unchanged
description: ContactStore::set_blocked runs UPDATE contacts SET blocked=?1 WHERE peer_user_id=?2 and unconditionally advances the state counter when affected>0. SQLite returns affected=1 even when the value was already equal to the new value — it counts matched rows, not rows where value changed. Result: every set_blocked(true) call on an already-blocked contact fires a spurious ChatContact/changes event. Fix: add AND blocked IS NOT ?1 to the WHERE clause so UPDATE only fires when value actually changes.
